local_geometry.input_order: 25 existing BC/material + 13 local geometry, followed by global context in decoder
local_geometry.limitations: Discrete boundary-node KNN/PCA, mesh-density dependent; unsigned node distance, not exact SDF

scope: 40 training CADs / 5 validation CADs; ver,hor,tor only; test CADs and dia locked

definition.fit_data: all labels of the selected training cases; no validation/test labels
definition.scale: 90th percentile of abs(stress), or RMS if that percentile is zero; floor 1e-12
definition.spread: pooled population standard deviation of asinh(stress / scale); floor 1e-8

scaler_fit_scope: train 40 CAD x ver/hor/tor, all original labels; validation uses fixed scaler

model.claim: GeoBC candidate baseline; no new-algorithm or generalization claim

decoder.precision: native TCNN FP16 computation, FP32 master parameters, float32 returned output

encoder.pooling: concatenated masked max and masked mean

model.conditioning: existing local BC/material features followed by global geometry descriptor
model.geometry_source: fixed per-CAD normalized xyz only; prefer unique original boundary FEM nodes
model.geometry_sampling: CAD-key/seed-stable sampling without replacement; masked padding for small clouds
model.context_gradient: index_select/concatenate preserve gradients through native TCNN inputs
model.context_training_cache: clouds only; re-encode once per unique CAD each optimizer step
model.control: none/id retain the same decoder condition dimension and width as shape
model.id_policy: fixed case identity codes for a diagnostic only; cannot encode unseen geometry

sampling: uniform distinct cases per batch; equal nodes per selected case, with replacement

geometry.canonical_source: one ver prepared geometry per train/validation CAD, reused for all loads

training_loss: case-balanced sampled mean squared error in fixed train-scaled centered asinh stress
evaluation: all original nodes; physical signed stress, no clipping; cloud context encoded once per CAD per evaluation
checkpoint_selection: minimum validation case_mean_relative_l2; train/test/dia do not select
precision: PointNet float32/high TF32; native TCNN FP16 compute, FP32 master, float32 returned output
claim: candidate baseline, not a new algorithm or an already established generalization result
